prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left-turn lane at a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas, when the collision occurred during a left turn. Driver 2 was proceeding southbound and struck the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was present during the impact. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and stated that pain began shortly after the collision. Responding officers observed that the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the reported angle and direction of impact, and no earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known or reported. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the details provided by the drivers, though no independent witnesses came forward. Both drivers and the Passenger were interviewed, and their accounts of the vehicle positions were consistent with one another. The driver of Driver 1's vehicle is listed as a named insured on the applicable policy. At this time it is not clear whether the reported injuries resulted from this collision, and the matter has been referred for further medical review.
